page.layout: One page of text in italic and roman type, full width at top; margin note at left beside the first lines; a large heading "IN" at right below the text; a woodcut ornament below. No page number, no running head.

main_text.p: puniendo, vos spernendo. Ego praeter testari nihil habeo. & hoc etiam addo, Siquid vsquam praeter religionem morésque veterum, non agnosco: & tibi adhaereo Statu felix Ecclesia, cui totam doctrinam Apostoli Petrus & Paulus cum sanguine suo profuderunt. Haec ex animo scripta, ut in animum demittas, te, per spes tuas & per quidquid carum est, Lector rogo.
main_text.head: IN

page.notes: <note side="left">Hoc de Romanâ Tertull. præscript. adu. hæret. cap. XXXVI.</note> The first lines are printed in italic with a roman passage ("Statu felix Ecclesia" and "totam doctrinam Apostoli Petrus & Paulus") set in roman type; the woodcut ornament below the text has no text. The line "puniendo, vos spernendo" begins mid-sentence and is a continuation from the previous page. Reading of "praeter testari" and "vsquam" is uncertain; "præscript." and "adu. hæ-ret." are as printed in the marginal note.
